$comment: Machine-readable AI usage metadata required by NASA Space Apps (https://github.com/nasa/spaceapps/discussions/2123). Keep in sync with README.md. Entries with "status": "to_confirm" must be completed by the team before submission.
project: OrbVital — Artemis Crew Health & Deep Space Radiation Engine

used_for: frontend and backend code audit (security, correctness, code quality)
development_tools.human_oversight: Team members defined the problem, architecture and clinical decisions, and reviewed and merged every AI change through pull requests. AI code was verified with automated tests, type checks, production builds and browser tests.

development_tools.tool: Other AI assistants used outside Git (e.g. ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, Cursor)

runtime_ai_features.execution: server-side only (GEMINI_API_KEY); offline fallback with DEMO_OFFLINE
runtime_ai_features.note: Stored clinical status comes from the deterministic HEALTH_BANDS rule table, not from a generative model.

runtime_ai_features.component: Face landmarks for rPPG heart rate, PERCLOS fatigue and sleep

runtime_ai_features.model: scikit-learn model trained by the team

generated_media.rule: Every AI-generated image, video or slide must carry a visible watermark or metadata and must not contain NASA logos, flags, insignia or mission identifiers.
